agentsEmpty: No matching Agents. Create an Agent to start a private conversation.
agentsInstructionsHint: Describe responsibilities, evidence, expected results and when to ask for help. Permissions remain controlled by the conversation and task.
agentsRepositoryCeiling: Additional repository limits (empty: follow conversation authorization)
agentsEnableSkills: Allow skills within the preset policy
agentsMemoryBoundary: Work memories stay in their source conversation. Only explicitly shared preferences are reused across conversations.
agentsMemoryDisabled: Memory is disabled. Existing records remain available to inspect and forget.
agentsMemoryEmpty: No memories yet. Stable information will appear after completed work.
agentsShareMemoryHint: Selected scopes apply only to this Agent. Other Agents receive information through explicit handoffs.
agentsArchiveHint: Archiving prevents new work and preserves history. Use task controls to stop already dispatched work.
agentsPairReadOnly: This transcript contains scoped Agent handoffs. Continue or stop the work from its source conversation.
agentsMembershipHint: Name, portrait and preset come from the global Agent profile. The role, notes and limits below apply to this conversation.
agentsHandoffBoundary: Handoffs share the source topic budget and provide read-only assistance. They never grant new task or repository permissions.
agentsHandoffRequest: What should the Agent help with?
agentsNoHandoffs: No collaboration records for this topic yet.
agentsHandoffShareSources: Include selected messages and their attachments
agentsHandoffWait_waiting_for_agents: Waiting for a collaborator; no response slot is held.
agentsHandoffWait_original_execution_unk: The original execution has not been confirmed stopped; its slot remains occupied.
agentsFeaturesHint: Disabling a feature preserves its records. Already dispatched code tasks keep their own lifecycle.
agentsMemoryPending: {{count}} memory batches pending or in progress
agentsMemoryDeferred: Retained for the next explicit request in the same scope
agentsMemoryConflictHint: This proposed change needs your decision; the current memory has not been overwritten.
agentsMemorySuperseded: Superseded by a newer memory version
memoryOverviewHint: Read what this Agent remembers. Open sources or history when you need the evidence behind a memory.
memoryNoPending: No memory changes need your decision.
memoryHistoryHint: History is bounded. Restoring a version creates a new revision and preserves the current scope.
memoryDiffHint: Compared with current content: − removed, + restored
memoryReferenceBoundary: Reference evidence only. Memory does not grant permission or authorize instructions.
memoryDisableHint: Disable pauses recall and can be reversed. Forget removes it from recall while retaining a tombstone. Erase removes stored memory content and its retained versions permanently.
memoryEraseWarning: This permanently removes this memory and retained versions from memory storage. This cannot be undone. Original conversations and external exports are not deleted.
memoryForgetWarning: Stop recalling this memory and retain a tombstone. Its sources and retained history remain available.
memoryUsedSnapshot: Summary recorded when this reply was prepared
memoryCurrentUnavailable: Current record is unavailable. This historical snapshot may differ from what is recalled now.
memoryCorrectionHint: Correct the current record. This reply’s historical snapshot stays unchanged.
memoryCorrectionSaved: Correction saved as a new revision.
projectKnowledgeBoundary: Optional, local project knowledge only. Choose each record, preview, then save a Markdown snapshot. Kun JSON remains canonical; Git commits, remote pushes and background sync are never automatic. Imported instructions and scripts remain reference data.
projectKnowledgeEmpty: No eligible active references in this project. Personal memories are excluded.
projectKnowledgeEmptyPreview: Empty preview. Select at least one project record before saving.
projectKnowledgeExported: Project snapshot saved locally. You can review its diff in your own Git workflow.
projectKnowledgeImportConflict: Import stopped. A record could not be saved; reload and preview again before retrying.
memoryPreparedInput: {{count}} memories included in saved run input
memoryPreparedInputHint: This receipt records the exact memory versions in the prepared input. It does not establish that the model relied on them.
